Summary Description: arXiv:2404.10184v1 [math.GR] 15 Apr 2024FINITE-INDEX ACCESSIBILITY OF GROUPS MAX FORESTER AND ANTHONY MARTINO ABSTRACT . We prove an accessibility theorem for ﬁnite-index splitti ngs of groups. Given a ﬁnitely presented group Gthere is a number n(G) such that, for every reduced locally ﬁnite G–tree Twith ﬁnitely generated stabilizers, T/Ghas at most n(G) vertices and edges.
